title: The verb/config co-occurrence uses `[\s\S]*?` across the newline-joined haystac…
body: The verb/config co-occurrence uses `[\s\S]*?` across the newline-joined haystack, so a verb in one field (e.g. prd.description 'add a webhook') and a standalone 'configuration' in an unrelated story title can co-trigger the cue. This matches the spec's stated 'co-occur anywhere in the haystack' intent, so it is intended, not a defect; noting only that a same-clause proximity bound would be higher-signal if false positives resurface.
